https://www.anthropic.com/threat-intelligence-report-september-2026 I hope its not duplicated post, but I have read the report only halfway through. With the signals they have in place they have disclosed so much intelligence from how a novice user can mass scan the github profiles to look for api keys and club it to supply chain, to how hackitivists and nation state actors can push narratives using bots all the way to UN. Also I wonder, openai being in news for solving mathematics problem which was unsolved for how many years, and then a mathematics researcher putting a post on mastodon, as to how they stole the conversation and used it and claiming they model solved it. Also biology misuse is something very interesting in anthropic report that I never would have guessed we would see. sub
